proof_ledger.abel: strict Stieltjes partial summation with pi(t)=t/log(t)*(1+delta(t)); sup_(t>=x)|delta(t)|->0
proof_ledger.fixed_partition: multiply finitely many fixed-r equivalents; no growing-degree uniformity
proof_ledger.interval: finite Euler-product intervals plus integer-tail Bonferroni bound, directed at precision 80
proof_ledger.subtraction: L2 subtracts exact A*T_y; L3--L5 subtract exact A*T_y+B*T_y^2; neither term may be replaced by its bare-PNT surrogate
